gemini-3-pro.feature: Gemini 3 Pro is Google's frontier reasoning and coding model with a 1M-token context window, used inside Google's Antigravity IDE, Gemini Code Assist, and as a selectable model in Cursor and other multi-model editors. Official API pricing is $2.00 per million input tokens and $12.00 per million output tokens (rates roughly double above 200K input tokens).

gemini-3.5-flash.feature: Gemini 3.5 Flash is Google's fast, cost-efficient model for high-volume coding completions and chat, trading some reasoning depth for speed and price. Official API pricing is $1.50 per million input tokens and $9.00 per million output tokens.

qwen0.5-coder-7b.feature: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct is the lightweight entry point into the Qwen2.5-Coder family, runnable on around 8-10GB VRAM, making it a popular choice for laptop-class local coding assistants and autocomplete.
